title: Interior Hessian Estimates for Semi-convex Solutions of the $σ_2/σ_1$ Equation with Lipschitz Right-Hand Sides
summary: Let $n\ge2$ and let $u$ be a smooth 2-convex and semi-convex solution of \[ \frac{σ_2(D^2u)}{σ_1(D^2u)}=f(x). \] We prove an interior Hessian estimate depending on the Lipschitz norm of $f$. The proof combines the integral approach of Chen--Jian--Zhou with the algebraic reduction of the quotient equation to a $σ_2$ structure. The main new point is a shifted algebraic inequality that yields a shifted trace Jacobi inequality in divergence form for $\log(Δu+a)$.
